description: Look up a Japanese patent or utility model by number and get its legal status: current stage (filing, examination, grant, refused, ceased), the latest status event, application/publication/registration numbers and dates, title, applicant or right holder, and FI classifications. Source: Japan Patent Office public register. Examples: application number 2020-000001, registration number 6770223.

number.description: Japanese number, e.g. "2020-000001" (application or publication, year-serial) or "6770223" (registration). Prefixes like 特願 are accepted.

number_type.description: What the number is. Default: application.

name: jp_patent_status
title: Jp Patent Status
